incident-bot: ALERT: GPU queue length > 250 for model-serving-usw2 for 3m. spot-pool-usw2 reports 95% preemptions in last 15m. autoscaler failed scale-up (API quota error). tagging severity: P2

maria (oncall): seeing this. hitting high tail latency on production routes. queues growing, some requests are 429ing. bringing up bridge.

vikram: on it, adding myself. I can try a manual scale if autoscaler is choking. what does the autoscaler error say?

incident-bot: autoscaler logs: 
```
ERROR 2026-03-15T09:07:12Z scale_manager.go:241 failed to request instances: cloudapi 403 QuotaExceeded: "GPUs quota exceeded for project"
```

toni: we have reserved-capacity in dedicated-reserve-usw2 with idle nodes — can we divert traffic or attach fallback pool?

maria (oncall): yes, runbook step 3: enable fallback routing to dedicated-reserve, throttle low-priority queues. I'm going to start that now. @vikram hold off on manual cloud requests until I try routing change.

vikram: ack. I'll prep a manual node request in case routing is insufficient.

maria (oncall): running command to flip routing policy (chatops):
```
# promote dedicated-reserve as fallback for model-serving-usw2
redwood-cli routing set --service model-serving-usw2 --fallback dedicated-reserve-usw2 --mode immediate
```

deploy-bot: deployment change queued by maria (oncall) — rolling update will apply to 12 routes.

maria (oncall): flipping throttles for background/embedding jobs:
```
kubectl patch configmap/route-limits -n infra --patch '{"data":{"embedding_priority":"1"}}'
```
Should drop noncritical load in ~30s.

eng-sre-rotation: SRE joining bridge. checking autoscaler controller — it has retries but backoff is long. cloud API returns quota errors so scaling requests are rejected. need to free GPUs or raise quota.

toni: can we evict spot nodes with long-running low-priority pods to free room? risk: preempting could worsen fragmentation. suggestion: drain a couple of spot nodes and migrate critical pods to reserved nodes.

vikram: I ran a quota check: project gpu quota = 100, used = 100. Reserved-pool has 12 GPUs free; we can immediately schedule critical serving on them if routing allows.

maria (oncall): confirmed routing shifted; metrics show queue length plateauing and p50 latency improving. still some 5xxs for requests that were queued > 60s earlier. marking customer-impact: partial degradation for inference requests (high latency + occasional 429/5xx).

customer-ops: we've had 3 customer reports about degraded response times. tracking customers A12, B7. Notified account reps.

eng-sre-rotation: next step: reduce spot-preference weight so autoscaler won't try to allocate only spot and hit quota. editing autoscaler config.

vikram: changing autoscaler policy now — lowering spotFraction to 0.4 and increasing reservedFallback to true.

incident-bot: CONFIG CHANGE: autoscaler-policy updated by vikram at 09:21Z.

toni: also kicked off a manual node request to cloud for +20 GPUs; it may take ~8-12m. watching provisioning.

maria (oncall): good. start a short postmortem stub in #postmortems and annotate timeline. I'll keep bridge open until stable and handoff to next oncall in 45m.

vikram: provisioning succeeded for +8 GPUs to dedicated-reserve; scheduler bound critical pods. queue draining now, in-flight token rates normalizing.

eng-sre-rotation: monitors show error rate trending down. still monitoring for flaky states from preempted pods (KV cache warmup). suggest a follow-up: run cache warmup job for critical models after we finish.

maria (oncall): agreed. runbook actions completed: fallback routing (step 3), throttle low-priority (step 4), autoscaler policy adjust (step 5), manual capacity request (step 6). putting incident into 'mitigated' state.

customer-ops: informing impacted customers with ETA for full recovery ~30m.

maria (oncall): handing off to @toni for the 45m watch. I'm out for break but reachable. tagging postmortem owner: @vikram.

toni: taking watch. will coordinate cache warmup and schedule postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident transitioned to MITIGATED by maria (oncall) at 09:47Z. severity downgraded to P3.

maria (oncall): summary for postmortem: root cause = GPU quota exhaustion + autoscaler affinity bias to spot-only pools; contributing = recent spot preemption spike and lack of warm reserved fallback. remediation actions: (1) raise project GPU quota, (2) implement autoscaler policy to natively prefer mixed allocation, (3) add runbook check to warm reserved pool at 50% queue threshold, (4) improve quota alerting earlier.

vikram: I'll own remediation items 1+2. creating JIRA now.

toni: I'll own item 3 (warm reserved runbook) and coordinate with capacity team.

maria (oncall): thanks team. closing bridge.
